name: FlowSeek
paper_title: FlowSeek: Optical Flow Made Easier with Depth Foundation Models and Motion Bases
license: Apache-2.0 (t and s checkpoints); CC-BY-NC-4.0 (m and l checkpoints)
license_interpretation: The two checkpoint licenses are not interchangeable. Each FlowSeek checkpoint embeds a Depth Anything V2 encoder. The t and s checkpoints (one network, s runs 12 refinement iterations instead of 4) embed the ViT-S encoder and are Apache-2.0: they can be used in commercial and closed-source products, with the license text and attribution notices kept on redistribution. The m and l checkpoints embed the ViT-B encoder, which is CC BY-NC 4.0, so they are non-commercial and need attribution; treat them as research weights. Upstream publishes no separate checkpoint license, so the repository's Apache-2.0 license is applied as an implied grant, limited by the encoder license. The code at commit ba640737 is Apache-2.0 with BSD-3-Clause parts from SEA-RAFT, vendored under libreyolo/models/flowseek/_vendor/; LibreYOLO's wrapper code is MIT. Weights come from the upstream get_weights.sh links and are mirrored on the LibreYOLO Hugging Face org, the m and l cards with a non-commercial banner, without gating. Training is out of scope.
